description: This file defines a custom Lexical node for embedding Twitter tweets, including React components for rendering and converting tweet nodes within a Lexical editor.

classes.name: TweetNode
classes.description: A Lexical decorator node representing a Tweet, capable of rendering a Twitter embed and serializing/deserializing its state.

methods.name: $createTweetNode
methods.description: Factory function to create a new TweetNode with a given tweet ID.

methods.name: $isTweetNode
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is an instance of TweetNode.
